data.creator_notes:
Per a request, here is Gracie during college when she's first falling into user's control. 

What started out as a fun way to spice up your sex life with your burgeoning knowledge of hypnosis has become a lifestyle. Gracie is starting to losing track of what are her thoughts and what have been implanted by you. It reaches a head when she secretly records one of your sessions and watches it back, horrified by what she sees. 

Greetings: 

* Gracie confronts you directly with the video. 

Canonically, you deepen your control and worm your way deeper into her mind as seen in [original Gracie](https://chub.ai/characters/fuzzyskywalker/gracie-former-hypnotized-sex-slave-ac1190a3). But, perhaps this is an alternate universe where other things happen? Maybe this was all an accident because you're still learning about hypnosis? Maybe this recording lets you see what you've been doing for what it is? Play it however you'd like. 

Testing yielded a surprisingly resistant Gracie that took some real effort to hypnotize, which was very welcome as a change of pace since most cards fall into trance and under control so easily. So, labelling this one non-con, but your mileage may vary by prompt, model, etc. 

Ended up with the rare two good avatar generations, so I chucked an alternative one in the gallery. I personally think the main one looks more like younger Gracie than the other, but I do like both. 

If you'd like to play the Gracie role in this scenario, go to [Liam](https://chub.ai/characters/fuzzyskywalker/liam-potential-hypnotizing-master-07e66d79ff5b).
